<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Contract" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/contract">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Query" name="Parts query"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offers" name="Shop offers"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Delivery" name="Parts batch delivery"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint email"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Contract">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Contractor" name="Contract project" processRef="Process_Contract"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Shops" name="Web shops"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Query" name="Query all shops" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Message_Query"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offers" name="Offers" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Parts order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstDelivery" name="First parts batch" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LaterDelivery" name="Subsequent parts batches" sourceRef="Participant_Shops" targetRef="Start_LaterDelivery" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder cheapest parts" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder fastest parts" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="Participant_Shops" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Complaint email" sourceRef="Task_Complain" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Contract" name="Contract" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_NeedParts" name="Parts needed for contract project"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_QueryShops" name="Query all web shops" messageRef="Message_Query"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffers" name="Receive offers with quantities, prices, and delivery times" messageRef="Message_Offers"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectCheapest" name="Select the cheapest parts"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OneShopSufficient" name="Can one shop supply enough parts?"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateOneShop" name="Allocate order to one shop"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AllocateSeveralShops" name="Allocate order across several shops"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AllocationMerge" name="Merge allocation paths"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateLists" name="Create a parts order list for each shop"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrders" name="Place parts orders" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" name="Receive first parts batch" messageRef="Message_Delivery">
      <bpmn:documentation>Parts arrive in batches in a random order, typically about two days earlier or later than expected.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartBuilding" name="Start building"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_BuildingStarted" name="Building started"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_NeedParts" targetRef="Task_QueryShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_QueryShops" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffers" targetRef="Task_SelectCheapest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_SelectCheapest" targetRef="Gateway_OneShopSufficient"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_OneShopSufficient" targetRef="Task_AllocateOneShop">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">oneShopCanSupplyAllParts</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OneShopSufficient" targetRef="Task_AllocateSeveralShops"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_AllocateOneShop" targetRef="Gateway_AllocationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_AllocateSeveralShops" targetRef="Gateway_AllocationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_AllocationMerge" targetRef="Task_CreateLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CreateLists" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrders"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrders" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFirstBatch" targetRef="Task_StartBuilding"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_StartBuilding" targetRef="End_BuildingStarted"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_LaterDelivery" name="Process subsequent parts batches" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_LaterDelivery" name="Parts batch arrives" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_LaterDelivery" messageRef="Message_Delivery"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateStock" name="Update stock for delivered batch"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_LaterDelivery" name="Batch stock updated"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Later_01" sourceRef="Start_LaterDelivery" targetRef="Task_UpdateStock"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Later_02" sourceRef="Task_UpdateStock" targetRef="End_LaterDelivery"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_StockBelowFive" name="Reorder when stock falls below five" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StockBelowFive" name="Stock below five" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_StockBelowFive">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">stock < 5</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderCheapest" name="Reorder the cheapest parts" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StockBelowFive" name="Cheapest reorder placed"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Five_01" sourceRef="Start_StockBelowFive" targetRef="Task_ReorderCheapest"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Five_02" sourceRef="Task_ReorderCheapest" targetRef="End_StockBelowFive"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_StockBelowThree" name="Reorder again when stock falls below three" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StockBelowThree" name="Stock below three" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_StockBelowThree">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">stock < 3</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderFastest" name="Reorder the fastest parts" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StockBelowThree" name="Fastest reorder placed"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Three_01" sourceRef="Start_StockBelowThree" targetRef="Task_ReorderFastest"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Three_02" sourceRef="Task_ReorderFastest" targetRef="End_StockBelowThree"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_StockZero" name="Complain when stock is zero" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_StockZero" name="Stock is zero" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition id="ConditionalEventDefinition_StockZero">
          <bpmn:condition xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">stock = 0</bpmn:condition>
        </bpmn:conditionalEventDefinition>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Complain" name="Email friends to complain about the web shops" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_StockZero" name="Complaint email sent"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero_01" sourceRef="Start_StockZero" targetRef="Task_Complain"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Zero_02" sourceRef="Task_Complain" targetRef="End_StockZero"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
